description:
Read or overwrite this workspace's handoff note at <workspace>/.venira/memory.md (action=read|write; write replaces it all, max 10000 bytes).
Use when: a task starts or resumes (read, after recent_files); before you finish or run out of context (write: goal, decisions, files touched, next steps).
Avoid when: lasting docs (write_file) or history (git action=log). Plain text on disk: no secrets.

action.description: read: return the saved note (exists=false + hint when none). write: replace it entirely with `content`.

content.description: write only: the full note (markdown, max 10000 bytes). Replaces the previous one; empty/missing content is refused.

if_version.description: write only: `version` from the last read ("new" if none); stale = conflict.
